en.headline: Customs seizes about 6800 suspected counterfeit hard disks worth HK$50 million
en.dek: Officers raided a suspected processing factory and warehouse on Thursday and arrested six people in the operation targeting fake computer storage devices.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it seized about 6800 suspected counterfeit hard disks with an estimated market value of about HK$50 million and arrested six people during a special operation on Thursday.
The operation targeted a suspected counterfeit hard-disk processing factory and storage warehouse. Customs later held a press briefing to provide further details of the action.

Under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance, anyone who imports, exports, sells or possesses counterfeit goods for sale commits an offence and is liable on conviction to a maximum fine of HK$500000 and imprisonment for five years.

zh.headline: 海關檢約6800件懷疑冒牌硬碟 拘6人 市值約5000萬
zh.dek: 海關周四採取特別行動，搗破懷疑冒牌硬碟加工工場及倉庫，檢獲約6800件貨品並拘捕六人。
body: 香港海關表示，周四採取特別行動，打擊懷疑冒牌硬碟加工工場及儲存倉庫，檢獲約6800件懷疑冒牌硬碟，估計市值共約5000萬元，並拘捕六人。
海關稍後舉行記者會交代行動詳情。案件仍在調查中。
根據《商品說明條例》，任何人進出口、銷售或為售賣用途而管有冒牌物品，即屬違法，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款50萬元及監禁五年。
